abstract: BACKGROUND: Choriocarcinoma is a highly malignant tumour which originates in developing trophoblast of pregnancy, most commonly following molar pregnancy. It is a potentially fatal disease, but current management protocols have turned the prognosis highly favourable. METHODS: This study was done on patients with gestational choriocarcinoma presenting to Gynae-B unit of Khyber Teaching Hospital Peshawar, between May, 1996 to December, 1997, diagnosed on the basis of clinical course and elevated level of HCG. Metastatic evaluation of the disease was done to assign different risk groups to the patients before selecting appropriate chemotherapy regimen for each patient. Results of the therapy were monitored by serial estimation of HCG levels. RESULTS: During this period 5 patients of choriocarcinoma were treated. In 2 (40%) cases choriocarcinoma developed after molar pregnancy whereas in 3 (60%) cases antecedent pregnancy resulted in spontaneous abortion. Four (80%) patients were from poor socioeconomic class, 3 (60%) were above 39 years of age and 4 (80%) were multiparous. Two patients (40%) were medium risk and 3 (60%) were high risk cases. There was no patient with low risk disease. EMA-CO (Etoposide, Methotrexate, Actinomycin-D, Cytocine, Oncovine) regimen was administered to all patients. Maximum number of cycles of chemotherapy given was 8. Only one patient developed drug resistance. Overall cure rate was 80% (4 patients survived out of 5 at two years' follow-up). CONCLUSION: Prognosis of gestational choriocarcinoma is favourable provided the appropriate therapy is administered early in the course of disease. Provision of free medical care should be considered for these patients to save their lives.
abstract_ja: 背景：絨毛癌は妊娠の絨毛の発育過程に生じる高悪性度腫瘍で、最も多くは胞状奇胎後に発生する。適切な治療プロトコルにより予後は大きく改善されているものの、潜在的に致死的な疾患である。方法：1996年5月から1997年12月までに、ペシャワールのKhyber教育病院産婦人科Bユニットで妊娠性絨毛癌と診断された患者を対象とした。診断は臨床経過とhCG値の上昇に基づいた。転移評価を行いリスク群に分類したうえで、各患者に適切な化学療法レジメンを選択した。治療効果はhCGの連続測定で追跡した。結果：この期間に5例の絨毛癌を治療した。2例（40%）は胞状奇胎後に発生し、3例（60%）は流産後に発生した。4例（80%）は貧困層、3例（60%）は39歳以上、4例（80%）は経産婦であった。中等度リスクが2例（40%）、高リスクが3例（60%）で、低リスクの例はなかった。全例にEMA-CO（エトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、Cytocine、Oncovine）レジメンを投与した。化学療法の最大サイクル数は8であった。薬剤耐性を生じたのは1例のみであった。全体の治癒率は80%（2年時点で5例中4例が生存）であった。結論：適切な治療を疾患の早期に行えば、妊娠性絨毛癌の予後は良好である。これらの患者には生命を救うため無償の医療提供を検討すべきである。
